facts.big-star: In the center floats one large yellow eight-pointed star, with seven smaller white eight-pointed stars around it.
facts.knee-foot: A naked woman kneels with her left knee on the ground and her right foot on the water.
facts.two-jugs: She pours water from two jugs: the jug in her right hand into the pond, the jug in her left hand onto the ground.
facts.streams: The water poured on the ground splits into several streams.
facts.ripples: In the pond, round ripples spread out from the spot where the water is poured.
facts.bird-tree: A bird perches in a tree on the hill on the right.
facts.far-mountain: A mountain can be seen far off on the left, and small wildflowers dot the green meadow.

glosses.two-jugs: Not pouring everything in one place, but filling both heart and daily life a little at a time.
glosses.big-star: A light that is not showy and stays lit for a long time.
glosses.knee-foot: A posture that leans on the ground while still resting a foot on the water (feelings).

reversedGloss.waning: Hope and energy fade, and it is hard to believe in herself.
reversedGloss.blocked: The flow of recovery is blocked for a while and feels slow.
reversedGloss.excess: Pouring everything out for others, her own pond dries up.

misdescriptions.wrong: One foot on the ground, one foot in the water.
Stars shine in the pitch-dark night sky.
There are six (or eight) small stars.
